title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Development Stream in Burundi, implemented by partners COPED and SADC in Makamba and Rumonge Provinces, aims to tackle the root causes of gender inequality and social exclusion. The programme aims to improve governance of, and thus access to, sexual and reproductive health services, and promote gender equality, including gender representation in community structures, by supporting rights holders to take action to advance their rights; influencing duty bearers and decision-makers to take action, and strengthening the agency of partner agencies and civil society. It specifically targets marginalised groups including returnee populations, youth, people with disabilities, Batwa, women and girls of reproductive age and survivors of GBV.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: BDI. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Programme objectives are not thematic. The primary purpose of the programme is to promote and support gender equality, including sexual and reproductive health rights. Work that contributes to specific SDG targets will span all objectives through complementary approaches and actions.
